description: I'm Deepakumar, a 2nd-year B.E. CSE student interested in Python, full-stack development, geospatial data and UI/UX. I use Python, Flask/Django, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL, PostgreSQL/PostGIS and Leaflet. With Virtual Warriors, I'm building FirePulse using real NASA MODIS and VIIRS hotspot data. Seeking teammates with skills in GIS/remote sensing, data science, satellite-data processing and visualization. Let's build a useful, evidence-based solution together!
